# Event Exited

This event is raised when the host process was running on the local machine and has exited.

###### Namespace: TopSolid.Kernel.Automating

###### Assembly: TopSolid.Kernel.Automating.dll

##### Syntax

```
public static event EventHandler Exited
```

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  EventHandler |  This event is raised when the host process was running on the local machine and has exited. |
